sanity_expectations: At fixed Cin and Vm, J rises with external concentration C and saturates at high C (Michaelis-Menten-like uptake).
The forward uptake term is suppressed as internal concentration Cin increases (trans-inhibition factor 1 - Cin/(Cin+Ktrans) decreases from 1 toward 0).
Back-leak contributions are non-positive relative to uptake and grow with Cin/(Cin+Kd); net J can become negative when C is small and Cin is large.
The electrical back-leak term changes sign/magnitude with Vm and vanishes as Vm -> 0.
J is finite and real everywhere in the sampled region.
excitation_report: sigma=0.05 (absolute std on J; ~1% of the dominant term). Per-term RMS multiples over the sampled 3D region (Sobol, is_ode=false): forward uptake with trans-inhibition = 97x; concentration-gradient back-leak = 7.3x (raised from 3.7x by increasing Jleak 1->2, since it shares Jleak with term 3); electrical/Vm back-leak = 22x. NEW term (E - parent = the trans-side inhibition factor -Jmax*T*C/(...)*Cin/(Cin+Ktrans)) peaks at 124x sigma, strongest at high external and internal concentration (C~17, Cin~20, Vm~-0.07). All terms and the new term exceed 5*sigma; no weak terms.

Roles: J is the determined output. C is the primary axis per the phenomenon. Cin and Vm were labeled input axes and genuinely appear as functional arguments (Cin in the trans-inhibition and back-leak saturations, Vm in the electrical exp/tanh factor); keeping both as sampling axes exposes their structure to symbolic regression, so they are confirmed as independent variables. T was labeled an input axis but the phenomenon explicitly fixes transporter abundance, so it is overridden to a constant parameter. All remaining symbols are fixed parameters at physiologically sensible magnitudes (Km=1 sets half-saturation, Ki=50 gives mild substrate inhibition, Jmax=10 vs Jleak=2 keeps back-leak ~20% of max uptake, Ktrans=10 within the suggested 0.1-100 range, F/R/Temp/z_solute physical constants). check_substitution confirmed a finite real value; excitation_check confirmed every term including the newly-introduced trans-inhibition term exceeds 5*sigma at sigma=0.05 after raising Jleak 1->2.
